card: Removes time-based mempool transaction expiry along with the -mempoolexpiry option and the mempool entry_time index. Age-based eviction is incentive-incompatible: empirical fleet analysis of over 930,000 expired transactions showed 92% were eventually mined anyway, causing redundant rebroadcasts and wasting relay bandwidth. Dropping the multi-index also removes an ordered-tree node per mempool entry and saves tree-update overhead. The -mempoolexpiry flag is retained as a hidden no-op that logs a startup warning.
changed_since_previous: Includes header cleanups, include-lint adjustments, and test rewrites that decouple wallet resend and USDT tests from mempool expiry.
evidence: Analysis of 938,157 expired transactions from a 15-node monitoring fleet between Feb 2024 and Oct 2026 showed 92% were later mined, only 8% never confirmed, and at least 34% showed rebroadcast evidence (PR description)
Issue #33510 details that mempool expiry eviction drops transactions that could be mined in the next block
problem: Age-based transaction eviction is incentive-incompatible because it drops transactions that are still mineable (such as low-feerate parents waiting for child fee bumps), triggering rebroadcasts that consume network relay bandwidth. In addition, maintaining the `entry_time` multi-index costs an ordered-tree node per entry and an O(log n) tree update on every insertion and deletion.

risk.why: Flaws in removing the index or eviction logic could cause inaccurate mempool memory accounting, memory leaks, or persistence desync.

scope_notes: Deletes test/functional/mempool_expiry.py and updates several tests (including USDT tracepoint and wallet resend tests) to trigger removals via RBF or restart rather than expiry.
summary: Removes time-based mempool transaction expiry, the `EXPIRY` removal reason, and the `entry_time` multi-index container from `CTxMemPool`. Retains the `-mempoolexpiry` startup option as a hidden no-op that logs an initialization warning when set. Updates memory usage accounting and reworks functional tests and fuzz harnesses that relied on age-based eviction.
